title: Cylindrical base
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on a new face. Within this face, draw a single loop containing a circle centered at coordinates (0.0091, 0.0091) with a radius of 0.0091 units. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0182 to this two-dimensional sketch to achieve the desired dimensions. Ensure that the scaled sketch remains aligned with the original coordinate system by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees and translating it with a vector of zero units. Extrude the scaled sketch along its normal direction by 0.75 units to form a solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical base are 0.01818181818181818 units in length and width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the circular face
circle_center = (0.0091, 0.0091)
circle_radius = 0.0091

# Create the circle in the sketch
workplane = workplane.center(*circle_center).circle(circle_radius)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
extrude_depth = 0.75
extrude_depth_opposite_normal = 0.0

# Perform the extrusion operation
r = workplane.extrude(extrude_depth)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq
import math

# Create the base workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the main body
r = r.moveTo(0.0057, 0.0022) \
     .threePointArc((0.0023, 0.0057), (0.0057, 0.0091)) \
     .lineTo(0.0057, 0.0091) \
     .threePointArc((0.0091, 0.0091), (0.0125, 0.0091)) \
     .threePointArc((0.0125, 0.0057), (0.0091, 0.0022)) \
     .lineTo(0.0057, 0.0022) \
     .close() \
     .extrude(0.75)

# Add circular extrusion
r = r.faces("+Z").workplane().pushPoints([(0.0091, 0.0057)]) \
    .circle(0.0057).extrude(-0.75)

# Cut the inner cylinder
r = r.cut(cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.0091, 0.0057) \
    .circle(0.0023).extrude(0.75))
